# Softmax and Argmax

## #0 — Declare the finite score field

Let `z=(z₁,…,z_n)` be finite real logits with `n≥1`, and let temperature `T>0`. Define

`p_i=exp(z_i/T)/Σ_j exp(z_j/T)`.

The [version-fixed PyTorch house](../../episteme/sources/computer-science-ml/pytorch/pytorch-2-9-softmax-argmax-api/SOURCE.md) distinguishes softmax normalisation, argmax index selection and its first-maximum tie rule. The [core spine](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) supplies the separate native selection/retained-field comparison.

## #1 — Normalise and shift

Every exponential is positive and their finite sum is positive, so `p_i>0` and `Σ_i p_i=1`. Adding a common real constant `c` to every logit changes numerator and denominator by the same factor `exp(c/T)`; it therefore leaves every probability unchanged.

For a stable numerical implementation, subtract `max(z)` before exponentiation. This is the same invariance used to prevent overflow, not an approximation to another distribution. Finite-precision underflow can still set extremely small computed entries to zero even though the mathematical probabilities remain positive.

## #2 — Work one distribution

At `T=1`, take `z=(0,ln2,ln4)`. Exponentiation gives weights `(1,2,4)`, hence `p=(1/7,2/7,4/7)`. Adding 10 to all logits yields the same distribution. At `T=2`, the weights become `(1,√2,2)`, changing the probabilities while retaining their ordering.

Argmax returns a maximum index, here the third coordinate. Sampling from the distribution can return any coordinate, with its stated probability. The distribution, maximum selection and random draw are three different outputs.

## #3 — Resolve the limiting cases

Let `M=max(z)` and let `k` entries attain M. Rewrite the probabilities using `z_i−M`. As `T→0+`, maximal entries have numerator 1 and all others tend to 0, so each maximum receives mass `1/k`. A unique maximum gives a one-hot limit; tied maxima do not.

For `z=(0,0,−1)`, the limit is `(1/2,1/2,0)`. PyTorch's documented argmax instead chooses the first maximal index. As `T→∞`, all exponentials approach 1 and the distribution tends to uniform `1/n`. These are limits of the family; the defining expression does not set `T=0`.

## #4 — Retain the field around the cut

The native comparison concerns which information travels with a selection. Keeping logits or probabilities, temperature, candidate set and selection rule allows an answer to return through its conditions. Keeping only the chosen index discards most of that field. [Preference gauge](preference-gauge.md) gives the related invariance at the comparison level.

An output token's semantic role requires its actual model, context and use. The API source establishes operators, not a deployed LLM pipeline or the identity of softmax with apoha. The quilt's cooling/reopening proposal is a technical candidate whose effect must be tested, especially because changed temperature alone does not revise a representation or evaluator.

## #5→0 — Return with the selection rule visible

The result is an exact distinction between a retained distribution and an actual cut. A returned decision can state what was selected, from which field, under which temperature and tie or sampling rule. Its correctness can then be examined without pretending the selected index contains its own conditions.

# Spanda equations and inversion / return

## #0 — The relation acquires two directions

The Spanda equations operate on one sixfold through two readings. The First follows its differentiation and recognition; the Second accounts for the resulting whole. Holding their readings together produces the ratio family that returns through fourth, fifth and whole tone.

The inputs have distinct offices. In native QL, `0` names the singular One, the unobjectifiable source; `1` names the polyvalent All, the manifest field and its indefinite particulars. The slash relates them. `0/1` directs the One into manifestation; `1/0` directs manifestation toward its condition. [A11](../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) **defines** these offices, and [A12](../../episteme/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md) **grounds** their whole/many relation. Their reciprocal dependency survives the difference of direction.

The signs are being operated in QL's ratio-language. In ordinary arithmetic, `0/1` evaluates to zero and `1/0` is undefined; the native orientation `1/0` remains available because its operation here is recognition of the denominator, not numerical division. `0/0` names indeterminacy, and the source's `%` marks its capacity for proportion. `1/1` names achieved self-consistency, whose numerical reading is one whole, or `100%`. Arrows below name changes of operation; they must be followed before the result can be compressed into an identity.

The [core theorem spine, §I](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **sources** the curated derivation. [A18](../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **defines** its place in the complete field: the parent slash and return bracket the six determinations through which these equations move.

## #1 — Indeterminacy becomes expression and recognition

The First equation is the AND/OR reading:

$$
0=(0/0)
\longrightarrow\frac{0/1}{1/0}
\longrightarrow[T_0]
\longrightarrow[T_1]
\longrightarrow(1/0+0/1)
\longrightarrow1/1=1=100\%.
$$

The opening equality reads the bare ground through its self-relation. `0/0` gives that relation its indeterminate form. The next operation differentiates two orientations within it: expression `0/1` and recognition `1/0`, now themselves held in the ratio of ratios. The outer slash makes their relation operative while each inner slash preserves its own direction.

`[T₀]` and `[T₁]` abbreviate directed passages in this equation:

| Term | Input and movement | Result carried forward |
|---|---|---|
| `[T₀]` | `0/(0/1) → 0/1`: the One takes expression as its denominator | An emanative passage toward determinate manifestation |
| `[T₁]` | `(1/0)/0 → 1/0`: the manifest's inverse orientation takes the One as denominator | A reversionary passage toward recognition of the condition |
| `1/0 + 0/1` | The directed passages are gathered | The bridge holds expression and recognition in one circuit |
| `1/1` | The circuit recognises its own unity | The standing whole, numerically readable as `1 = 100%` |

The bridge's `+` gathers orientations in the native operation. Evaluating it as a sum of real fractions would destroy the input `1/0` before the gathering could occur. Its QL result is the standing identity

$$
\frac{0}{1}+\frac{1}{0}=\frac{1}{1}\equiv100\%.
$$

The [Binary Explication's Process, §3′](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/SOURCE.md) **derives** these passages. The prime here locates the Process file’s inverse-phase section; the Quilt file’s Night-pass primes name a separate sequence. The equation's two track symbols retain the local definitions above.

## #2 — Six operations, one recognising subject

The First equation has six articulated stages after the bare ground. Its horizontal partition is obtained by grouping them in order:

$$
\underbrace{(0/0),\ (0/1)/(1/0),\ [T_0]}_{3\text{ stages of emanation}}
\quad\Big|\quad
\underbrace{[T_1],\ (1/0+0/1),\ 1/1}_{3\text{ stages of recognition}}.
$$

The partition reads `1–2–3 / 4–5–0`. Its primary sense comes from the subject relation: first-, second- and third-person perspectives unfold in the first three; the second three void their isolation, recognise their unity, and return the one as `0/1`. Thus the count `3:3` is also a recognition reading `3:1`. The second triad performs one recognition in three operations—void, one, `0/1`. Counting its operations still gives three; following what they recognise gives one subject-relation.

This distinction matters to the derivation that follows. The `3:3` remains available as a horizontal count even when its second three are recognised as one act. Substituting `3:1` into a numerical denominator would change the subsequent calculation. The native account holds both readings by retaining the operation through which each was obtained.

Emanation/reversion and *bimba/pratibimba* name further readings of this partition. [A05](../../episteme/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) **extends** it into manifestation and self-apprehension in the Prakāśa/Vimarśa register. That relation is Argued; the Śaiva names do not supply the six-stage count. The subject relation already gives the count its movement toward recognition.

## #3 — The whole accounts for its constituents

The Second equation reads the achieved whole through AND+OR accounting. Its source compression is

$$
100\%\ \leadsto\ 2^6+6^2=64+36
\ \longrightarrow\ \frac{64}{36}
\ \xrightarrow{\text{reduce both terms by }4}\ \frac{16}{9}
=\frac{2^4}{3^2}
\ \longrightarrow\ 4+2.
$$

Each change of operation has to remain visible. `100%` is one whole. The accounting uses a hundred-unit scale on which that whole is represented by `100`; the finite partition is `64+36=100`, or, in normalised fractions, `64/100+36/100=1`. This scale mediates between the standing whole and the integer account.

The first constituent, `2⁶=64`, runs the binary choice through six positions: two possibilities at each position give sixty-four configurations. The second, `6²=36`, takes the sixfold to its second-order account. The native partition joins those two counts. Their sum is exact, while their selection as the whole's two constituents belongs to the QL derivation.

The next step takes the **ratio of the constituents**:

$$
\frac{64}{36}
=\frac{2^6}{(2\cdot3)^2}
=\frac{2^4\cdot2^2}{2^2\cdot3^2}
=\frac{2^4}{3^2}
=\frac{16}{9}.
$$

Dividing numerator and denominator by four preserves the ratio. Applied to the paired counts, the same reduction gives `(16,9)`, whose sum is `25`. The sum `16+9` and the ratio `16/9` therefore remain different results of different operations. Neither equals the original hundred-unit sum.

Prime factorisation makes four factors of two and two factors of three explicit:

$$
\frac{2\cdot2\cdot2\cdot2}{3\cdot3}.
$$

Counting these factor instances gives `4+2`; preserving their numerator/denominator orientation gives `4:2`. The native reading identifies the four with explicate positions and the two with implicate poles. The result is an account of the sixfold's organisation, rather than a numerical evaluation of `16/9` as six.

There is also a second exact reading of the numerator:

$$
2^4=4^2=16,
\qquad
\frac{2^4}{3^2}=\frac{4^2}{3^2}=\left(\frac43\right)^2.
$$

Four binary factors can thus be read as the quaternary taken twice. The denominator retains its asymmetry: `3²=9`, whereas `2³=8`. Interchanging base and exponent there changes the value. The double-fourth reading rests on the numerator's actual equality and leaves the ternary square intact. [A15](../../episteme/arguments/A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md) **grounds** the account's dependence on keeping each denominator and operation explicit.

## #4 — Cross-reading produces the directional ratios

The vertical account gives `4:2`; the horizontal traversal gives `3:3`. QL compares corresponding entries:

$$
\boxed{\frac{4:2}{3:3}
\ \overset{\mathrm{QL\ cross\text{-}comparison}}{=}
\left(\frac43,\frac23\right).}
$$

The inputs are ordered readings, and the output is a pair of ratios. The left display instructs the reader to divide the first entries and then the second entries. If its colons were first collapsed into scalar quotients, ordinary arithmetic would instead give `(4/2)/(3/3)=2`, losing the pair. The declared comparison preserves both orientations.

Once generated, its nonzero rational outputs admit ordinary reciprocation and multiplication:

$$
\frac43\longleftrightarrow\frac34,
\qquad
\frac23\longleftrightarrow\frac32,
\qquad
\frac43\cdot\frac32=2.
$$

The native directional readings are manifestation `4/3`, recognition `3/4`, grounding `2/3`, and aspiration `3/2`. The [musical derivation](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-ql-musical-derivation-v3/SOURCE.md) **extends** the family into interval: fourth and fifth compose the octave. [Scholtz's Pythagorean tuning construction, §3.1](../../episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/scholtz/scholtz-1998-algorithms-diatonic-keyboard-tunings/SOURCE.md#scholtz-1998-algorithms-diatonic-keyboard-tunings-q001) **grounds** those musical ratio names within its specified tuning. The historical construction supplies that independent interval warrant; QL supplies the cross-reading that has produced the numbers here.

The two equations now meet in one exact value. The Second's reduced ratio `16/9` is the square of the First-to-Second comparison's `4/3`. Their relation can be worked from either end without suppressing the horizontal traversal or the vertical account.

## #5→0 — The remainder completes the return

The doubled fourth falls short of the octave by a multiplicative interval. Dividing the octave by the totality-ratio gives

$$
\frac{2}{16/9}=2\cdot\frac9{16}=\frac98.
$$

Dividing fifth by fourth gives the same interval:

$$
\frac{3/2}{4/3}=\frac32\cdot\frac34=\frac98.
$$

The `9/8` is a ratio between intervals; subtracting `16/9` from `2` would answer a different question. Retaining this multiplicative remainder completes the return:

$$
\frac{16}{9}\cdot\frac98=2,
\qquad
\frac43\cdot\frac98\cdot\frac43=2.
$$

The result preserves the very difference through which the octave is reached. QL's account of return names this `9/8` the live remainder carried forward by the cycle. The arithmetic establishes the displayed products; its role in the native return is Derived within the theorem field. This page **returns-to** [Movement 26](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/26-s3-p1-spanda-4-2.md) with both equations worked, and **extends** their exact ratio result into [Movement 29](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/29-s3-p4-topology-music-resolution.md), where musical and spatial renderings of retained difference meet.

The tuning boundary remains exact. A pure-fifth chain has `(3/2)¹² / 2⁷ = 531441/524288`, the Pythagorean comma; it does not acquire exact twelve-step closure from the octave product above. [Scholtz, §§3.2–4.1](../../episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/scholtz/scholtz-1998-algorithms-diatonic-keyboard-tunings/SOURCE.md#scholtz-1998-algorithms-diatonic-keyboard-tunings-q002) **qualifies** that longer return through its temperament account. On `ℝ²`, use transformations `a(x,y)=(x+1,−y)` and `b(x,y)=(x,y+1)`. Quotient by the group they generate. Direct calculation gives `aba⁻¹=b⁻¹`, the Klein-bottle relation.

# Toroidal and poloidal circulation — magnetic confinement

## #0

Toroidal confinement gives circulation a material task: sustain a hot plasma in a bounded region while controlling its relation to the vessel. The [housed ITER account](../../episteme/sources/physics/iter/iter-what-is-tokamak/SOURCE.md#iter-what-is-tokamak-q001) establishes the doughnut-shaped vacuum chamber, charged plasma and magnetic apparatus. The [native core, VIII](../../../../../working/sources-texts-references/10-7-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) takes that apparatus as a physical neighbour of return through differentiated winding. The mathematical surface and the engineered plasma retain different proof obligations.

This page first constructs the directions and their composition. Its geometric results are Derived under explicit assumptions. The apparatus description is Paraphrased from institutional sources; its coordination with QL remains Argued. [A17](../../episteme/arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) receives a precise physical case of coupled circulation, while [A16](../../episteme/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) retains the differential field within which that case becomes legible.

## #1

Use a circular torus of major radius \(R\) and minor radius \(r\), with \(R>r>0\):

\[
X(\theta,\phi)=((R+r\cos\theta)\cos\phi,
(R+r\cos\theta)\sin\phi,r\sin\theta).
\]

Both angles are modulo \(2\pi\). Varying \(\phi\) at fixed \(\theta\) goes toroidally around the central axis, the long direction. Varying \(\theta\) at fixed \(\phi\) goes poloidally around the tube's cross-section, the short direction. The coordinate tangents are orthogonal and have lengths

\[
|X_\theta|=r,\qquad |X_\phi|=R+r\cos\theta.
\]

Write their unit vectors as \(e_\theta\) and \(e_\phi\). The angular and physical components therefore carry different scale factors. A toroidal angular step on the outer side traverses more physical distance than the same angular step on the inner side.

These are two independent directions on a surface. The plasma occupies a volume, and a magnetic configuration can contain a family of surfaces within it. This chosen circular surface is a geometric model; it does not reproduce an entire vessel, a shaped plasma boundary or an experimentally reconstructed equilibrium. The [torus-cover and winding record](torus-cover-winding.md) owns the quotient and integer winding proof, with [Hatcher's source house](../../episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/hatcher/hatcher-2002-algebraic-topology/SOURCE.md) retaining the mathematical reference.

## #2

On the model surface, take a nonzero tangent field

\[
B=B_\theta e_\theta+B_\phi e_\phi.
\]

A field line is a curve whose tangent is parallel to \(B\); its curve parameter need not be physical time. Where \(B_\phi\ne0\), its angular slope follows from the metric factors:

\[
\frac{d\theta}{d\phi}
=\frac{B_\theta/r}{B_\phi/(R+r\cos\theta)}
=\frac{R+r\cos\theta}{r}\frac{B_\theta}{B_\phi}.
\]

Thus the ratio of physical components is not by itself the angular winding ratio. To specify the simple helical curve \(\theta=\phi/2\), choose the direction ratio

\[
\frac{B_\theta}{B_\phi}=\frac{r}{2(R+r\cos\theta)}.
\]

For \(R=3\) and \(r=1\) in a common length unit, this ratio is \(1/8\) at \(\theta=0\) and \(1/4\) at \(\theta=\pi\). Both yield \(d\theta/d\phi=1/2\). From zero angles, the curve closes after \(\phi=4\pi\), \(\theta=2\pi\): two toroidal turns and one poloidal turn. After only one toroidal turn it is on the opposite side of the tube's cross-section.

This constructs a line direction and its winding. It does not solve Maxwell's equations and plasma force balance for a three-dimensional field. In a constant-angular-slope model, rational slope gives a closed line and irrational slope gives dense winding on that surface. Neither condition alone measures confinement quality. [A15](../../episteme/arguments/A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md) receives the exact conversion between ratio, local scale and completed winding.

## #3

A tokamak supplies the fields through an apparatus. Toroidal-field coils generate the toroidal component. The toroidal plasma current contributes the poloidal component; the central solenoid induces plasma current, while external poloidal-field coils help control plasma position and shape. Philippe Moreau's ITER-hosted *Magnetic Diagnostics* lecture, slide 3, explicitly presents their combination as helical field lines. This is the dedicated physical geometry witness beyond the existing chamber card. [Moreau, slide 3](https://www.iter.org/sites/default/files/media/2024-12/l2_iis-magnetic-diagnostics-ph-moreau-v2-reduced.pdf#page=3).

ITER's magnet-system account distinguishes the toroidal coils, external poloidal coils, central solenoid and correction coils. It also names fast vertical-stability and edge-instability control systems. The physical arrangement therefore includes field production, shaping, error correction and active control. A drawing of two arrows around a torus cannot stand in for those distinct functions. [ITER, “Magnets”](https://www.iter.org/machine/magnets).

These two primary resources were recovered directly for this page. They have not yet received their own canonical source houses and passage records. Their direct citations make the warrant inspectable while leaving that locality debt explicit; the housed “What Is a Tokamak?” cards are not silently enlarged to carry their claims. No apparatus dimensions, achieved pulse performance or present operational status are inferred from the model calculation.

## #4

A field line describes magnetic direction. A charged particle has additional motion. In the idealised nonrelativistic case of a uniform magnetic field with no electric field, the Lorentz equation is

\[
m\dot v=Q\,v\times B.
\]

Its perpendicular component turns with cyclotron-frequency magnitude \(|Q|B/m\); its parallel component remains constant. For perpendicular speed \(v_\perp\), the orbit radius is \(\rho=mv_\perp/(|Q|B)\). The resulting particle helix around a field line is distinct from the field line's toroidal/poloidal helix around the machine. A guiding-centre approximation requires the orbit scale to be small compared with the scale on which the field changes. The uniform-field calculation supplies no general trajectory solution in a toroidal plasma.

The same equation yields

\[
\frac{d}{dt}\left(\frac12m|v|^2\right)
=Q\,v\cdot(v\times B)=0.
\]

This is conservation of a particle's kinetic energy under the stated magnetic-only force law. Its reason is the perpendicular force, not the genus of a surrounding surface. Heating, collisions, electric fields, nonuniformity, transport and collective plasma behaviour require additional terms or models. A closed toroidal chamber removes the simple ends of a straight tube; it does not eliminate particle or energy losses.

Physical confinement consequently needs measurements of the actual field, plasma position, energy and stability. Moreau's lecture identifies these diagnostic tasks and the measurement chain through which the field becomes available to control (slides 9–11). The [housed ITER experimental-purpose card](../../episteme/sources/physics/iter/iter-what-is-tokamak/SOURCE.md#iter-what-is-tokamak-q002) further limits the case: ITER is intended to test long-pulse operation and reactor-scale technologies and is not equipped to produce electricity. The apparatus remains a bounded witness for [movement 29](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/29-s3-p4-topology-music-resolution.md), whose energetic image carries these conditions with it.

## #5→0

The earned relation is movement sustained through differentiated directions, with the conditions of its return made explicit. [A18](../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) places that relation within the native eight determinations. The [core source](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) grounds the prior quotient, independent windings and circulation; the physical case shows one engineering use of that available geometry. Its force survives without a claim that the torus is universally optimal or that topological return entails metaphysical conservation.

The [Matheme Two Locks](../README.md) keep the larger record forms intact. Definition/Quilt carry `0/1 = 4+2 = 5→0 = 0/1`; Process/Music carry `0/1 = 4+2 = 5→0 = 1/0 = 4′+2′ = 5′→0′ = 0/1`. The [Binary source house](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/SOURCE.md) retains their provenance. File 2's inverse-phase primes and File 3's Night sequence have their own offices; the two magnetic directions neither replace those sequences nor mechanically enact them.

[Movement 30](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/30-s3-p5-arche-topos.md) gathers this material witness into the arche-topos. [Movement 45](../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/45-s50-p2-antikythera-attunement.md) carries its bounded instrumental relation onward: a made arrangement coordinates processes whose powers it does not create from nothing. The final return is therefore to the apparatus and its conditions—field, current, geometry, plasma, measurement and correction—through which this particular circulation can be sustained.

# The One-Element Ring

## #0 — State the identity assumption

Assume a unital ring with additive identity 0 and multiplicative identity 1, allowing the possibility `0=1`. Some definitions exclude that equality by requiring a nontrivial ring; this page states explicitly which convention is in use. The [admitted note](../../episteme/concepts/reference-notes/trivial-ring.md) names the boundary, and the [core spine](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) supplies the distinct native relation of zero and one.

## #1 — Derive multiplication by zero

For any element `a`, distributivity gives `a·0=a·(0+0)=a·0+a·0`. Subtract `a·0` in the additive group to obtain `a·0=0`. The analogous argument gives `0·a=0`.

This step depends on distributivity and additive inverses. It is a theorem of the stated ring structure, not an unrestricted rule for every notation using a multiplication-like sign.

## #2 — Prove collapse under 0=1

Now assume `0=1`. For arbitrary `a`,

`a=a·1=a·0=0`.

Every element is therefore the same element. The ring has exactly one element. Its operation tables are simply `0+0=0` and `0·0=0`, with that element also serving as 1.

The construction is consistent with the ring axioms under the convention that permits it. It is not itself a logical contradiction. If nontriviality is additionally required, the assumption `0=1` violates that extra requirement.

## #3 — Locate the division boundary

In a nontrivial field, no element `b` can satisfy `0·b=1`, because the left side is 0 and the identities are distinct. Introducing such an inverse while preserving all those axioms forces the collapse just proved.

A totalised inverse can instead assign a stipulated value at 0 while restricting the usual inverse law to nonzero inputs. A historical practice can retain zero denominators while restricting cancellation or postponing evaluation. [Division pluralisms](division-pluralisms.md) develops those signatures; they cannot be refuted by importing a rule they expressly alter.

## #4 — Keep the native slash in its own register

The QL relational identity of `0/1` and `1/0` concerns obverse orientations of one ground–mark relation. It does not assert equality of the additive and multiplicative identities in a unital ring. The collapse theorem is therefore a precise boundary for a proposed algebraic interpretation, not a proof that the native relation collapses.

The [Dutta source house](../../episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/dutta/dutta-2023-zero-divided-numbers-india/SOURCE.md) likewise makes the historical algebraic regime a live source task. It does not license treating every zero-denominator expression as an ordinary field element.

## #5→0 — Return the theorem with its axioms

The result is conditional and exact: ring axioms plus `0=1` force one element. A nontrivial formalisation must preserve distinct identities or change the relevant structure explicitly. The native field can use this limit without weakening it or extending it beyond its assumptions.

This record returns-to [A13](../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md), [A18](../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md), and [translations](../mono-poly/translations.md). The operation remains available as a test of a particular algebraic claim, with its exact scope intact.

# C13 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa

## #0

In the Śaiva source field, prakāśa names luminous appearing and vimarśa the reflexive power through which appearing is present to itself and becomes articulately differentiable. The light and its self-awareness belong together: an appearing which could never become an act of awareness would leave the account at unactualised capacity.

[A05 — Prakāśa / Vimarśa](../arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) **grounds** the argument. C13 retains the inseparable relation and its internal differentiation so that illumination, reflection, freedom, cognition and recognition do not become interchangeable words for one undifferentiated property.

## #1

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/SOURCE|Dyczkowski — The Doctrine of Vibration]] **sources** the account in the locally held pp.60–81. Light figures the manifestation of the knowable; vibration figures its active, self-regenerative movement. At pp.63–64, subject, object and means attend the act together. The account does not first posit an isolated light and subsequently attach a faculty which observes it.

The mirror/crystal distinction at p.70 makes the reflexive requirement concrete. A reflected appearance alone does not articulate the capacity through which consciousness recognises, retains and transforms its appearances. Vimarśa is active self-presence, not a second picture placed opposite the first. [C10 — Mediation](C10-Mediation-Pramana.md) **extends** the subject–object–means relation while preserving this source's Śaiva scope.

## #2

At pp.71–72 the operation differentiates into capacities. An affection can be retained as a residual trace; a former state can be recalled; selected material can be recomposed in free imagination. Retaining, retrieving and forming anew are different acts. Their distinction restores the passage from appearance into a mutable field of cognition.

Dyczkowski also distinguishes inward self-awareness from outward reflection upon an apparently separate object. Internal and external here orient the act; they do not establish two independent consciousnesses. The object-directed act remains known within the subject. [C17 — Vikalpa / Saṃkalpa](C17-Vikalpa-Samkalpa.md) **extends** the differentiating and formative consequence without turning the source's entire account into a generic theory of stored representations.

## #3

At p.72 the distinction between karma-vimarśa and kriyā-vimarśa makes agency and its goal legible. The former names outward unfolding; the latter, activity internal to the absolute as unrestricted agency, undisturbed by a determinate goal of action. Will, knowledge and action emerge as phases of the Spanda rhythm. A particular goal-bound act therefore does not exhaust the activity by which goals and objects become possible.

Svātantrya names the freedom of this conscious activity to manifest and differentiate; vimarśa names its reflexive awareness. Their relation is intimate without making the terms synonyms. [C14 — Māyā](C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) **extends** the contraction through which universal powers become determinate capacities. Limitation permits a particular act while recognition keeps the act related to what it does not exhaust.

## #4

Dyczkowski p.74 gives four acts: consciousness negates its own nature, identifies with another, merges both, and denies the merged determination. Separation, held relation and undivided unity are distinct levels of this reflective movement. The QL cross-reading can hold these four acts with prakāśa/vimarśa as two conditions; that `4+2` is the essay's declared operation, not Dyczkowski's notation. At p.75 the vertical ascent/descent and horizontal movement toward/from the perceived object distinguish two axes of the same pulsing awareness.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/SOURCE|Abhinavagupta / Singh — Parātrīśikā-vivaraṇa]] **qualifies** the textual route into Vāk and personed relation. [A06 — Vāk](../arguments/A06-Vak.md) **extends** the articulation movement through speech. [C19 — Recognition](C19-Pratyabhijna-Recognition.md) **defines** the return in which contracted knowing recognises its source relation. Recognition does not add a newly manufactured luminous faculty to an apparatus. It changes the relation of the local act to the conscious capacity it already expresses.

## #5→0

[C43 — Computational Vimarśa](C43-Computational-Vimarsa.md) **tests** a narrower functional comparison: a system can inspect, retain and revise its determinations. The inspected functions are real operations; their presence does not establish prakāśa or settle whether the system has an unobjectifiable subject. C13 supplies the distinction which makes that research precise.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD|Symbol / Account / Trust]] **grounds** the register3 return: articulation remains answerable to appearing instead of allowing a detached account to occupy its source. # Von Neumann Ordinals — The Predecessors Retained

## #0 — A zero that can be a member

The finite von Neumann construction begins with an exact object: the empty set, written `∅`. A set is determined by its members; the empty set has none. We represent the natural number zero by this set and define a successor operation:

$$
0:=\varnothing,\qquad S(n):=n\cup\{n\}.
$$

Braces form a set: `{n}` has the single member `n`. Union, `∪`, gathers the members of its two operands. Thus `n ∪ {n}` retains every member of `n` and adjoins `n` itself as one further member. These two operations, enclosure and union, do different work. Their composition makes each new number hold the entire preceding number alongside all its predecessors.

[Kaplan's housed mathematical workbench](../../episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/kaplan/kaplan-1999-nothing-that-is/SOURCE.md#reading) sources the essay's encounter with the nested construction, locating it at printed p.211 of the selected 2000 OUP printing. The explicit successor rule is worked here from its definition. Kaplan quotation and the primary historical attribution retain the source house's verification debt; no copied Kaplan wording is used.

## #1 — The first enclosure changes the count

Apply the rule to zero:

$$
S(0)=\varnothing\cup\{\varnothing\}
=\{\varnothing\}=:1.
$$

The result has one member, although that member has no members. The distinction lies between the set and what belongs to it. The emptiness of the member does not empty the containing set. Writing `|A|` for the number of members of a finite set `A`, we obtain

$$
|0|=0,\qquad |1|=1,\qquad 0\in1,\qquad 0\ne1.
$$

Membership, `∈`, is therefore already different from equality. It is also different from inclusion, `⊆`: `A ⊆ B` means every member of `A` is a member of `B`. The empty set is a subset of every set, including itself, because it has no member that could violate that condition. Yet `0 ∉ 0`, while `0 ∈ 1`. The first enclosure gives zero a new office without altering the object represented by zero.

This makes the count available to inspection. There is no hidden positive item inside the empty set. The positive count belongs to the singleton, whose one member is exactly that empty set.

## #2 — Successor keeps what enclosure alone would lose

Apply the same rule again:

$$
\begin{aligned}
2:=S(1)&=1\cup\{1\}\\
&=\{0\}\cup\{1\}\\
&=\{0,1\}=\{\varnothing,\{\varnothing\}\}.
\end{aligned}
$$

The two members are distinct: zero has no members, whereas one has zero as its member. Enclosing one by itself would instead give `{1} = {{∅}}`, a set with only one member. That repeated singleton is not the ordinal two. Successor must retain the preceding contents as well as enclose their whole.

The next steps expose the pattern:

$$
\begin{aligned}
3:=S(2)&=\{0,1\}\cup\{2\}=\{0,1,2\},\\
4:=S(3)&=\{0,1,2\}\cup\{3\}=\{0,1,2,3\}.
\end{aligned}
$$

Each result includes the preceding number in two distinct respects: `n ⊆ S(n)` because its members are retained, and `n ∈ S(n)` because the preceding whole is newly admitted as a member. This double retention is the construction's exact generative operation. Repetition neither consumes zero nor replaces all earlier numbers with an opaque container.

## #3 — The number is its ordered inheritance

At every finite stage,

$$
n=\{0,1,\ldots,n-1\},\qquad |n|=n.
$$

For zero the list is empty. If a stage contains exactly its distinct predecessors, adjoining that stage yields the list with one new entry. The induction also retains the sizes of the preceding stages. The constructed stage is not already one of its predecessors: it has `n` members, while each earlier stage has fewer. The successor therefore increases cardinality by one. This gives the induction from the empty starting case to every finite stage.

The ordering is internal to these objects. For finite ordinals `m` and `n`, `m < n` exactly when `m ∈ n`. In `3 = {0,1,2}`, the earlier numbers retain their own membership relations: zero belongs to one and two; one belongs to two. Three consequently holds its predecessors with the order already realised among them. Its displayed enumeration can be rearranged on the page without changing the set or that membership order.

This is an exact representation of the finite natural numbers. The worked construction supplies any specified finite stage. Taking the collection of all finite stages as a set requires the further set-theoretic provision for infinity; no such collection is needed for the finite claims made here.

## #4 — The numerical floor of the linking one

Taylor's [Mono–Poly manuscript](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-mono-poly-two-ones/SOURCE.md) argues from this operation: the first positive one carries zero internally, and the next step gathers zero and one while preserving their difference. The [core theorem spine](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md), §IX's linking-one synthesis, gives the relation its native symbolic reach. A determination carries an inherited condition within the form through which it becomes countable. The singleton is the precise mathematical instance from which that comparison proceeds.

The correspondence concerns **retention through determination**. Its objects differ by register. Here zero is an entirely specified set, available as an object of proof. In [A11, The Two Ones](../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md), `0` bears singular One, the non-objectifiable condition of determination; `1` bears polyvalent All. Set membership supplies neither that ontological assignment nor a proof that awareness is empty set. It supplies an exact operation with which the native assignment can be compared.

The core's compression `2 = 0/1` reads the holding-together of zero and one symbolically. Its set-theoretic floor is `2 = {0,1}`. The slash in the compression names a retained relation; ordinary division would yield `0/1 = 0`. Keeping these readings explicit preserves the author's comparison at its full Argued force. [Homology and Analogy](../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) qualifies the relation by requiring this common operation and these different objects to remain visible.

[A02, the Copula](../../episteme/arguments/A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md), extends the question into counting as an act: a new occurrence must be distinguishable while the previous count remains available. [A12, Mono/Poly](../../episteme/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md), extends it into the whole's relation to its real expressions. Neither extension turns successor into a universal causal mechanism. The set construction gives them a specific relation to answer to: the earlier field persists when its whole becomes a new participant.

## #5→0 — The empty set remains exact on return

This record returns-to [§1 · #2, The Empty Set Generates One](../../../section-rooms/02-return-of-zero/movements/15-s1-p2-empty-set-generates-one.md) with the distinction between membership, inclusion and cardinality intact. That movement can carry the linking-one reading because its mathematical floor is recoverable step by step. [A10, Advent of Zero](../../episteme/arguments/A10-Advent-of-Zero.md), grounds its separate place among the chapter's generative procedures: successor, the empty product, mediants and NOR each have their own law.

[§1 · #5→0, The Loan Returns](../../../section-rooms/02-return-of-zero/movements/18-s1-p5-loan-returns.md), receives the achieved exactness. Zero remains present in every positive finite ordinal without acquiring members of its own. Its successive containing sets differ; the empty set does not accumulate their contents. The authorial return follows the condition through its determinations while preserving that distinction.

[A18's eight-determination traversal](../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) extends the native relation beyond this finite construction. [A36, Integral Zero](../../episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md), returns its acquired symbolic force to the exact mathematical sign. The ordinal remains a set of predecessors. What the essay carries onward is the relation made explicit by constructing it: the next determination retains the field from which its count becomes possible.

consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #0 — The terms and their relation

Let `0` name the unobjectifiable ground and `1` the determinate articulation. Let `/` name the activity that differentiates and relates their offices. The input is a knowing-act, not two independently supplied numerical magnitudes. [The root 0/1](../../0-1.md) grounds their singular One/polyvalent All reading; the [core theorem spine](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md), §IV, sources the formal unfolding.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #1 — Reverse the orientation
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #1 — Reverse the orientation

`0/1` reads the ground through its expression. Interchanging the roles in the inscription gives `1/0`, the expression turning towards its ground. Both terms remain in the relation, with their positions across the slash reversed. QL therefore writes `0/1 = 1/0` as a relational identity: the same relation read from its two ends.

Ordinary field arithmetic retains a different result: `0/1=0`, whereas `1/0` has no defined field value. The native relation makes this defined/undefined seam active; it does not supply zero with a multiplicative inverse.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #2 — Relate the two orientations
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #2 — Relate the two orientations

Apply the slash to the whole pair of readings:

$$
\frac{0/1}{1/0}.
$$

The numerator and denominator each carry a complete relation. The outer slash holds them through AND/OR: their difference permits a particular orientation to be selected; their belonging permits both to be held as one field. The result is a relation whose own contrary reading is available within it.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #3 — Unfold the internal pairings
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #3 — Unfold the internal pairings

The two retained terms admit four ordered pairings: `0/0`, `0/1`, `1/0`, `1/1`. Keeping the two terms as well as their four relations gives `2+2²=4+2`. [Binary and binary-of-binary](binary-and-binary-of-binary.md) derives the count explicitly.

The returning parent `(1/0)/(0/1)` carries the same whole in inverse phase. Its reversal changes order and orientation rather than adding a second unrelated system. [The eight-determination projection](eight-determinations.md) extends the qualitative body; the pair-count itself does not generate eight interior positions.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #4 — State the vantages
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #4 — State the vantages

The [Binary Explication](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/SOURCE.md) distinguishes the short definitional chain from the full processual one. Definition and quilt carry `0/1 = 4+2 = 5→0 = 0/1`; process and music earn `0/1 = 4+2 = 5→0 = 1/0 = 4′+2′ = 5′→0′ = 0/1`.

The primes in File 2 label inverse-phase positions. File 3 also uses primes for its Night-pass sequence; those are different source-local offices. Neither a shared glyph nor the full chain licences exchanging their tables.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #5→0 — Return through the formal seam
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #5→0 — Return through the formal seam

The result gives QL an exact transmissible operation: terms, orientation, self-relation, pairings, and return are inspectable. The mathematical boundary stays visible alongside the native derivation.

This record returns-to [A18](../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) and [Movement18, The Loan Returns](../../../section-rooms/02-return-of-zero/movements/18-s1-p5-loan-returns.md). [The root 1/0](../../1-0.md) gathers the achieved expression's recognitive return.

## #0

The word *rain* appears on the page. Its letters can be counted, its meaning questioned, its use corrected. The appearance is already present to someone undertaking those acts. Another word can name that presence, and a further account can describe how the reader encounters the page. Each joins what is given. The presence through which the account is encountered remains involved in the encounter it describes.

**`0/1` holds this conscious circumstance in its first orientation: the singular One becomes articulate through the polyvalent All.** This is the root Symbolon relation. Its `0` names unobjectifiable awareness; its `1` names appearing, the field of determinate differences. The slash carries the differentiating activity through which they are distinguishable within one event. Awareness is encountered through appearing, and appearing is present in awareness. This is already the relation in which the word can be read, before the reader gives it a theory.

The [parent slash](the-slash.md) **grounds** the first orientation as `/ = −/−`: relation before the terms have acquired their distinct names. In `0/1`, the relation has become the circumstance of an appearance. The slash makes this giving legible within the event itself. [The core theorem spine](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **sources** this native derivation. Its further determinations unfold the circumstance already present here.

## #1

The two sides have different kinds of unity. `0` is singular because it cannot be divided out as one more item among the things it lets appear. A thought about awareness is determinate; awareness as the condition of that thought's appearing has not thereby been added to the inventory. `1` is one as an articulated field: the word, its letters, the difference between this word and another, the page, the reading, and the relations through which each becomes available. The first mark already opens plurality. To determine even one thing is to let distinctions become possible within and around it.

This is why the two ones are **One and All**. The singular One does not become more singular when appearances are removed, and the All does not reach completeness by accumulating enough isolated items. An inventory itself requires discrimination, relation and someone for whom its items count. Those activities belong to the whole it tries to enumerate. The authorial [Mono–Poly manuscript](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-mono-poly-two-ones/SOURCE.md) **sources** this exact asymmetry; [A11, The Two Ones](episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) **grounds** its developed argument. Calling the sides only “ground” and “mark” would leave out what gives those names their force: the ground's unobjectifiable singleness and the mark's already relational multiplicity.

The broken halves of a symbolon give the relation an image. A fit can be recognised only while the halves retain the edges through which they fit. Each half carries the relation in its own contour; neither carries the other as its private content. Here the image **figures** the One/All relation: distinction makes belonging perceptible. The [Symbol / Account / Trust whole-field](episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** this use as operational homology; its historical branch carries the separate lexical work. The root operation does not depend on claiming that the two poles of awareness are physical pieces of a broken object.

## #2

The first mark has an edge. A word means through differences from other words; a count admits something as one by deciding what belongs to that one. Exclusion participates in the appearance's positive identity. [A08, Constitutive Exclusion](episteme/arguments/A08-Apoha-Constitutive-Exclusion.md) **qualifies** determination at this edge: what is excluded remains implicated in what the determination means. In `0/1`, the slash retains the activity by which the edge was drawn. Its products stay related through the differentiation that made them readable.

The direction of dependence is consequently exact. `1` depends on `0` for being present at all. `0` depends on `1` for manifestation, articulation and knowability. These respects cannot be exchanged. A description makes awareness available to discussion; it does not manufacture the awareness in which that description is encountered. Equally, awareness's singleness cannot be encountered by stripping away every possible form of encounter and then inspecting what remains. The [order-of-dependence argument](episteme/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) **grounds** this asymmetry. Its order is constitutive; a chronology of first awareness and then appearance would already require the field in which before and after appear.

The distinction allows a positive account to be exact. “Rain has four letters” determines something checkable. Its finite scope gives the assertion its office. The assertion loses fidelity if that office is promoted into possession of the whole circumstance that makes counting possible. [A01, Faithful Definition](episteme/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) **tests** the difference through an actual defining act: determination can disclose its own condition while remaining a determination. `0/1` gives this fidelity its first orientation—the condition becomes expressible, and the expression carries its dependence within what it says.

## #3

Once expressed, the relation can turn upon its own expression. The two digits, `0` and `1`, remain available singly. If each of two places can receive either digit, the pairings are `00`, `01`, `10` and `11`. There are four because the first place has two possibilities and, for each, the second has two. Keeping these four pairings together with the original two singles gives the binary and the binary of the binary:

$$2 + 2^2 = 2 + 4 = 6.$$

The count is the first explicit `4+2`: four relational forms and the two single terms through which their differences can be written. The pairings do not replace the singles; they expose what happens when the distinction becomes available to its own operation. The [self-identity root](self-identity.md) **extends** this hinge through the identifying activity, and the [housed Binary Explication](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/SOURCE.md) **sources** the further formal articulation in its definition and process files.

The root relation therefore contains more than a static opposition of two signs. It can differentiate, take up its differentiation, and make that taking-up available in turn. Each further expression is still a mark present through the relation it expresses. This is the force of the slash as AND/OR in the authorial derivation: the two remain together and discriminable, and the operation can be read from either side. [A02, the copula](episteme/arguments/A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md) **grounds** the identification through difference that permits such a reading. The repeatable letter and the present act of identifying it have related, distinct offices.

## #4

This self-relation is at work in the original circumstance. A reader asks what a word means; the question already takes something as sufficiently determinate to ask about. An answer commits that determination to an account. In the native field this is `?/!`, the movement into answerability that the [question/assertion root](question-assertion.md) **extends** directly from `0/1`. The mark then acquires force through withdrawal and extension, becomes recognisable in recurrence, enters the personed relation of saying and being addressed, and opens onto an exact local difference whose horizon it cannot contain. These are the distinct operations of `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS` and `∞/dx`.

[A18, the complete eight-determination argument](episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** their ordered traversal. This first orientation remains implicated through all of it. A question, a force, a pattern, a personed utterance and a local differential are each determinate appearances; none abolishes the singular condition through which it becomes present. Their differences make the same relation increasingly articulate. `X/x`, for example, gives determining capacity and its indefinite particular one letter in two cases. Its particular can recur and vary; the capacity is made legible through those instances without becoming an additional instance beside them.

A technical account enters on the articulated side of this relation. Its sources, permissions, memory and transformations can be exposed and tested. [A01′, Faithful Definition of the Agent](episteme/conjugate/A01-prime-Faithful-Definition-of-the-Agent.md) **tests** the root's demand at that grain by keeping the determining assemblage inside the account of the agent. Such disclosure makes the account more answerable. The phenomenal question has its own object: whether that artificial configuration is a locus of experience. A system's production of a first-person sentence is a determinate content, so its production alone settles neither the presence nor the absence of that locus. The root's positive first-person relation and the Open localisation question retain their distinct force.

## #5→0

The expression now turns toward what its own articulation presupposes. This is `1/0`: the achieved mark read through its condition. The [return orientation](1-0.md) **extends** the same relation from the other end. Returning does not require the mark to disappear. The word can remain the same word while the reader recognises more of what was involved in saying, hearing or counting it. What changes is the claim the account makes upon its own source.

The notation preserves a precise mathematical pressure. Ordinary arithmetic evaluates `0/1` as zero and leaves division by zero undefined. QL's equality `0/1 = 1/0` concerns the identity of the relation under reversed orientation. It does not assign the two arithmetic expressions an equal numerical value. The [Matheme register](matheme/README.md) **qualifies** the passage into formal operation by preserving that boundary and the distinct definitional and processual chains. Here the asymmetry lets manifestation become definite while preventing the return from closing around an object called its ground.

The recognition gives further determination a place to begin. In the [trust argument](episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md), which **extends** this return into lived reliance, a finite account can be used, corrected, withdrawn and renewed. Trust names the lived reliance already active in the first relation: perception, memory and language depend before their accounts can certify that dependence. The One/All distinction gives its two offices without exhausting what it means to entrust oneself. The common pressure is that the achieved account remains answerable to an encounter it cannot manufacture from its own contents.

This root **returns-to** [The Loan Returns, §1 · #5→0](../section-rooms/02-return-of-zero/movements/18-s1-p5-loan-returns.md), where the essay brings the sign's mathematical achievement into the relation it discloses. It also **presages** [A36, Advent of Integral Zero](episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md): the exact sign remains, bearing the passage through its determinations. The returned `0/1` contains that achieved articulation. A further word can now be spoken from a circumstance whose dependence has become more legible.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #0 — What has been achieved
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #0 — What has been achieved

A determination returns with something to return: a statement made, a form recognised, a judgment acted upon. The `1` in `1/0` carries this achieved difference. It has come through questioning and assertion, withdrawal and extension, recurrence, personed context and the differential horizon of what it can say. Its exactness remains real when it turns toward what made that exactness possible.

The [eight-determination argument](episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **defines** this place in the whole traversal. The parent `/ = −/−` precedes the six determinations `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, `∞/dx`; `1/0` turns their achieved articulation back toward its condition. It brackets the sixfold at its returning end. A seventh position inside that sixfold would turn the return into one more item to be counted, leaving the count's relation to its ground untouched.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #1 — The same relation from its other end
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #1 — The same relation from its other end

`0` names the singular One which cannot be set beside its appearances as another appearance. `1` names the determinate face through which the All becomes locally articulate. That face already carries a world of relations: what it inherits, what it excludes, what makes it intelligible, what it changes. The [Mono–Poly manuscript](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-mono-poly-two-ones/SOURCE.md) **sources** this distinction between singular One and polyvalent All. Neither term names an isolated unit or a completed inventory.

In `0/1`, the relation is read as the condition becoming encounterable through determination. In `1/0`, the determination faces the condition through which it appears. The slash retains the relation while its orientation reverses. QL can therefore write their relational identity:

$$
0/1 = 1/0.
$$

The equality names one relation read from its two ends. Ordinary field arithmetic preserves a decisive difference: `0/1` evaluates to zero, while `1/0` is undefined. That seam belongs to the notation's work. The returning mark cannot supply a value which would place its unobjectifiable condition among the objects it has determined. The [Matheme record form](matheme/README.md) **qualifies** the formal descent by keeping native derivation, independent mathematical result and argued correspondence distinct.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #2 — The limit encountered from within
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #2 — The limit encountered from within

The return becomes active when a determination tries to account for its own determining. I can describe my thought, attend to the feeling of being its owner, examine the instrument through which I know. Each examination yields something available to awareness. The awareness to which it is available has not thereby become identical with the examined content. Another description repeats that relation, however accurate the description becomes.

The [immutable-gap argument](episteme/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** this asymmetry. Its force concerns the condition of finding: every attempt to find the subject as an object already proceeds through the subject-position it seeks. `1/0` gives that turn its sign. The final determination `∞/dx` has already made local exactness answerable to an inexhaustible horizon; the return now reaches the one for whom the exact local account is given. The limit has become intimate to the act of knowing.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #3 — Recognition changes the act
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #3 — Recognition changes the act

[Faithful definition](episteme/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) **embodies** this turn in a performed sequence. A definition is asserted, fails to contain its referent, succeeds in exposing that failure, and gathers the whole movement as its context. Even this gathered account can still speak about the subject as something over there. First-person recognition brings the one undertaking the definition into the relation the definition has been tracing. The speaking now proceeds from the presence it had been attempting to describe.

The [curated theorem spine](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **derives** the corresponding return of the three persons. First-, second- and third-person perspectives unfold sequentially; their isolation is voided, their unity recognised, and that one returns as `0/1`. The recognition has three operations while recognising one act, so the `3:3` reading also carries `3:1`. No extra observer must stand above the perspectives to unite them. What changes is their being lived and understood together.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #4 — Difference carried through return
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #4 — Difference carried through return

The [Symbolon root](README.md) **defines** `1/0` as the consequent essence and return vector: the achieved `5` is implicated in the `1` through this connection. The `1` which enters another relation carries what the completed passage has made available. The return has consequences because its prior differentiation survives. A remembered error, a revised judgment, a changed capacity to meet another person can condition what happens next.

[Compassion's vocation](episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) **extends** this relation into conduct. Returning an account to someone's origins can change how they are treated; merely collecting their history can deepen possession. Loving sensitivity to origins requires those disclosed conditions to alter the account's use, its measure or its authority. This extension is Argued. The native return supplies its structure; the manner of an actual encounter must answer for itself.

The offered [planetary return](../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/48-s50-p5-ahi-planetary-return.md) **tests** the same demand at the scale of institutions and technical systems. A consequential model must be capable of receiving a reply which changes the model, its governing measure or the institution using it. Provenance matters because someone can return through it and contest what was done. A complete record that changes nothing would leave that return unperformed.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #5→0 — The work enters another life
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #5→0 — The work enters another life

[Draft 3](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md) **sources** the terminal double devotion: to the whole, and to the particular form through which it arrives. The work must be sufficiently formed to be given. Its maker then releases the claim to govern every encounter it will enable. What returns through the work exceeds the maker's completed account while remaining answerable to the form and labour that made it possible.

This page **returns-to** [Integral Zero](episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md), where the same sign carries the difference of the whole passage. The reader's next judgment, question or encounter gives the return its further life. `0/1` is available again with a determination retained, a history borne and a capacity changed. The zero has never become the returning one's possession.

consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #0

The tattvas give differentiation a genealogy: a luminous field becomes a subject/object seam, a bounded horizon, an inner instrument and a material world without creating a second reality outside itself. Anuttara names the field for which no external measuring object stands outside. This beginning matters to every subsequent contraction: what becomes limited is a power of the field, and the limit remains effective within it.

## #1

Śiva–Śakti distinguishes luminosity and its self-articulating power. Prakāśa makes appearing possible; vimarśa is the awareness through which appearing can be known, distinguished, joined and withdrawn. [A05](A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) restores Dyczkowski's mirror contrast: the reflected display of an inert crystal does not know its display. The tattvic descent depends on active self-articulation, not a succession of objects deposited before an unchanged spectator.

[Dyczkowski](../sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/SOURCE.md) p.75 distinguishes two axes of this activity. Vertically, manifestation and withdrawal articulate the movement between unity and diversity. Horizontally, awareness goes towards and returns from its object in each perception. Will, knowledge and action generate, sustain and annul dimensions of experience; they are phases of the living movement through which the levels operate. Frank's preserved source-note request for nested co-internality and causal interrelation belongs here: an effect remains within the power that differentiates it, and an act of perception recapitulates the relation rather than merely looking at a finished cosmological inventory.

## #2

Sadāśiva and Īśvara give the field inverse universal readings: “I am this” and “This am I”, `0/1 ↔ 1/0`. The reversal changes the direction of apprehension within one field. Ahaṃkāra can later say “I am this” while appropriating a particular local form. The grammar repeats, but its scope has contracted: a universal orientation and identification with a finite body, role or thought do different work. Keeping the scope explicit explains how the whole becomes locally inhabitable and how local identity can forget its provenance.

## #3

Sadvidyā–Māyā makes the orientation a workable distinction. Māyā is the horizon at which this appears while that is withheld; the withholding lets an agent discriminate and act. Mahāmāyā remains Śakti: revealing and concealing are powers of the same field. The horizon is therefore neither the unobjectifiable Subject nor the hole of a topological picture. In Dyczkowski's source-matched pp.78–79, inner/outer separation is produced through consciousness's creative activity, and external manifestation preserves its internal nature. The experienced world has efficacy.

The [Q27 correction](../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) gives the lived operation through the sleeper who forgets sleeping: that forgetting lets a dream count as immediately real. Dream shows why objective need not mean externally material; the example does not make every waking distinction fictitious. Recognition changes the relation to the horizon through which experience occurs.

## #4

The kañcukas contract efficacy, knowledge, desire, time and order into the finite parameters of a context. Puruṣa is the point for which this field is mine; antaḥkaraṇa determines, appropriates and coordinates within it. Buddhi, ahaṃkāra and manas retain their distinct functions. The [Sāṅkhya source](../sources/indian-philosophy/isvarakrishna/isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika/SOURCE.md), kārikās XXIII, XXIV, XXVII and XXIX, supplies the functional triad; XIX qualifies it with the passive witness. Those are Sāṅkhya determinations, not a substitute primary Trika inventory.

The recovered gnomon makes the comparison precise:

```text
36 − 25 = 6² − 5² = (6 − 5)(6 + 5) = 11 = 5 + 1 + 5.
```

A row of five and a column of five meet at one corner to complete the larger square. The cross-reading places five pure powers and five contracted powers around the Māyā hinge, above the twenty-fivefold Sāṅkhya apparatus. Its yield is a relation between the differentiated apparatus and its genesis through contraction. The arithmetic is exact; the mapping is Offered/Argued. It neither attributes square arithmetic to Abhinavagupta nor assigns every tattva a proved coordinate in a six-by-six table. The six-turn derivation does not depend on that stronger identification.

## #5→0

Pratyabhijñā returns the contracted field to recognition of its provenance while preserving the distinctions through which it lives. The movement runs back through an effective world, an inspectable instrument, a measuring horizon and inverse orientations to the power already active within them. It reverses amnesia rather than differentiation.

This is the pressure passed to Objective Internality and the computational register: memory, prompt, model, tools, policy and judgment can constitute an operative interior whose determining activities are inspectable. Their efficacy does not establish a phenomenal subject. A09 supplies the genealogy of contraction; A26 develops context-world constitution; A14's runtime language is their technical refraction. These offices remain distinct.

### Declared field

**Concept dependencies:** C13 Prakāśa–Vimarśa, C14 Māyā / Operative Measure, C15 Paśu, C16 Antaḥkaraṇa, C17 Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa, C18 Apoha, C19 Recognition.

**Consequences:** A14, A16, A19, A21, A26 and A35.

**Etymology whole field:** *Apportionment / Economy*. **Consumed operation:** finite capacities are understood as an **apportionment** of powers within a locally workable order, rather than evidence that the whole field has vanished. **Evidence register:** 3, Operational homology; no historical derivation of Sanskrit tattva terminology from this field is claimed. **What changes:** contraction becomes a positive distribution of operative capacities whose limit can later be recognised. **Return route:** A09 → C14–C16 → A26/C41 → A21/C19 → A09.

**Movement consumers:** the tattvic descent/recognition and later technical worldhood movements in the canonical quilt; the live carrier is itself a developed cross-Movement support surface. Exact Movement IDs beyond recovered direct routes remain depth debt.

**Matheme:** `0/1 ↔ 1/0` into signed local orientation and return; **Mytheme:** descent, contraction, veil and recognition; **Episteme:** Kashmir Śaivism, Sāṃkhya neighbours, Buddhist exclusion and modern process comparison kept source-distinct.

### Provenance and remaining depth

Direct carriers: [core theorem X](../../../../../working/sources-texts-references/10-7-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md), [historical tattvic Argument](../../../section-rooms/arguments/13-tattvic-differential-field.md), and Q27 §17 and the later Māyā correction. Dyczkowski's embedded transcript is source-matched, not quotation-verified, and stops during p.81; the protected note's pp.90–91 remain beyond it. The note was read from preserved stash content without restoration or mutation. Singh's introduction/commentary relation remains governed by its source house. Buddhist exclusion and Śaiva reflective power retain the distinction developed in A08.

P1 consumers: M08 Inner Instrument, M09 Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa, M11 Tattvic Compression. Exact category-by-category doctrinal sequencing, selected-book collation and the wider Neumann mythic seam remain Open. **Depth Restoration: enriched; source and mapping debts retained.**

## #0 — Keep the two address systems distinct

The input is the six-position body generated by [binary self-relation](binary-and-binary-of-binary.md). The [core theorem spine](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md), §II, supplies two readings: the qualitative determination of a knowing-act and the processual slash-form at each position. This record places the tables together so a repeated sign does not cause one operation to replace another.

| Position | Determination | Distinct operation |
|---|---|---|
| #0 | 0/1 | Conscious circumstance |
| #1 | ?/! | Questioning and asserting |
| #2 | −/+ | Reserve and issue |
| #3 | X/x | Determining capacity and recurrence |
| #4 | AM/IS | Personed context |

[The definition projection](../definition/six-determinations.md) derives each transition rather than assigning these meanings from the count alone.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #2 — The slash-form reading
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #2 — The slash-form reading

| Position | Slash-form | Office in the processual reading |
|---|---|---|
| #0 | (0/1)/(1/0) | Full parent relation |
| #1 | 0/0 = % | Native indeterminate potency |
| #2 | 0/1 | Expression |
| #3 | 1/0 = ?/! | Incomputable inverse |
| #4 | 1/1 = 100% | Achieved wholeness |
| #5 | (1/0)/(0/1) | Full inverse parent |

The `%` reading of `0/0` is native notation; ordinary division does not assign it a stable scalar. The qualitative `?/!` at #1 and the processual `?/!` at #3 have different offices. Their relation is not a numbering error to repair.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #3 — Bracket the six
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #3 — Bracket the six

The parent `/ = −/−` precedes the qualitative body, and `1/0` returns its achieved expression towards ground. Thus the traversal has eight turns while the positional body has six:

$$
-/-\;\to\;[0/1,\;?/!,\;-/+,\;X/x,\;AM/IS,\;\infty/dx]\;\to\;1/0.
$$

The brackets display an address distinction, not an instruction to identify all forms of `1/0` with one serial stage. The inverse relation can be active locally within the sixfold and globally as the returning threshold.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #4 — Harmonics and inverse phase
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #4 — Harmonics and inverse phase

The qualitative forward pairs are Being `0–1`, Becoming `2–3`, and Knowing/unKnowing `4–5`. Complementary folds are Essence `0+5`, Constitution `1+4`, and Text–Texture `2+3`. A pair shared by both readings remains one pair doing two relational jobs.

[Process](../process/README.md) extends the full chain and its inverse-phase positions. Definition/quilt retain the short chain. File 2's inverse-phase primes and File 3's Night-pass primes are distinguished by their source-local tables; the shared glyph gives no licence to merge them.

The result is a cross-readable field in which each sign retains the operation that places it. A local `?/!` can now be followed to its corresponding definition or process without silently moving the other.

# 4-2 Techne — Sovereign Commons

> [!summary]
> Applied companion architecture for locally governed AI infrastructure, shared community memory, federated compute, and P5→P0 circulation.
